svg.text: An arena goes back to the operating system only when every pool in it is empty, which in a

text.font-family: Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: long running program is rare, because one surviving object anywhere in an arena keeps the

text.font-family: Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: whole thing. This is why a process that peaked at two gigabytes usually still looks like a

text.font-family: Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: process that is using two gigabytes, and why the next allocation is fast.
